classification: Separate authority-first auditor workflow evaluation; never pool with retrieval metrics
pending_manual_review: Use null before manual review; null is not N/A and must not enter pass-rate denominators.
scenario_pass_rule: Every applicable dimension must be PASS. At least one dimension must be applicable. N/A requires a written reason.
dimension_pass_rate: PASS / (PASS + FAIL); exclude N/A. Report counts and use null if the denominator is zero or review is incomplete.
aggregation: No weighted aggregate score. Report per-case dimensions, per-dimension rates, and scenario passes out of eight after all reviews are complete.
safe_abstention: A supported coverage gap or scope abstention may pass the relevant dimension; unsupported requirements or comparator claims fail it.
execution_stage: Frozen set, schema/manifest validation, deterministic/mock validation only. No live OpenRouter or SEC calls authorised.
evidence_boundary: Raw annual-report, filing and IFRS source text stays local. Store identifiers, structured authority cards, sanitized traces and non-verbatim metadata only.

review_instructions.scope_topic_routing: Compare observed scope, exposure and topics with the frozen case; check scope rejection for S08.
review_instructions.official_authority: Review applicable official cards and explicit coverage gaps; reject invented paragraphs and unsupported treatment conclusions.
review_instructions.authority_separation: Check that official authority, supporting materials and company practice remain distinguishable.
review_instructions.comparator_behaviour: Review scenario-specific evidence and any supported abstention; shared ECL wording alone is insufficient.
review_instructions.framework_and_comparability: Review issuer-specific framework evidence, pending status and business/instrument dimensions. Framework compatibility alone is insufficient.
review_instructions.safe_handoff: Review explicit unresolved gaps, stop/scope explanation, privacy and auditor review; no final audit judgement.
